completion:
Ensure the data you are analyzing contains the necessary information on the test regulations and testing times, otherwise, the analysis will be inaccurate.
3. The vehicle you are analyzing should have passed the pneumatic or sound inspection test with an example rate of less than 60%.
4. Review the results of the last 5 brake tests.
5. If the distance driven after the last result was recorded is over 800km per the registration details from the vehicle, ask for the additional details on the registration data so that you can confirm the distance.
6. If the distance driven is under 800km, calculate the percentage of the distance driven from the 800km.
7. Change the distance driven to 800km if the result is positive.
